447301.overview: Puckman is yet another clone of Pac-Man. The protagonist is confined in a maze and must collect all pellets in order to advance to the next level and so on. Hostile ghosts move about trying to eliminate our protagonist, and any physical contact will result in the loss of one life. Also strewn around some key spots are a limited number of power pellets which enable the player to switch roles for a number of seconds during which contact is fatal to the ghosts instead. This iteration keeps a high score table and provides on-screen instructions for new players.
